title: Q9. SQL查询语句的执行顺序是怎么样的？

sections.title: Q9. SQL查询语句的执行顺序是怎么样的？
sections.md:
```SQL
FROM / JOIN → ON → WHERE → GROUP BY → HAVING
→ SELECT → DISTINCT → ORDER BY → LIMIT
```

![Image](https://internal-api-drive-stream.feishu.cn/space/api/box/stream/download/authcode/?code=NGI1YmUwYmZmY2UyNDI3NDQ4ODAxMzcyZWFmZDNiZjBfZjE5NWM2MWIyMDIyOTVmZGMyNjFlOTA0NTc2NTQxNjJfSUQ6NzY0NDYwMDcyNjMxMTc1MDg2M18xNzkzMjU0MDQ4OjE3OTMzNDA0NDhfVjM)

所有的查询语句都是从FROM开始执行，在执行过程中，每个步骤都会生成一个虚拟表，这个虚拟表将作为下一个执行步骤的输入，最后一个步骤产生的虚拟表即为输出结果\.

```SQL
(9) SELECT
(10) DISTINCT <column>,
(6) AGG_FUNC <column> or <expression>, ...
(1) FROM <left_table>
(3) <join_type>JOIN<right_table>
(2) ON<join_condition>
(4) WHERE <where_condition>
(5) GROUP BY <group_by_list>
(7) WITH {CUBE | ROLLUP}
(8) HAVING <having_condtion>
(11) ORDER BY <order_by_list>
(12) LIMIT <limit_number>;
```
